caption: The drawing depicts a man with light skin and a full mustache, facing to the viewer's left, slightly tilting his head back and looking upward. He is dressed in formal attire consisting of a long, dark-colored overcoat that reaches past his knees, a white dress shirt, a tie, and light-colored trousers. The man's hands are placed at waist level, grasping the opening of the coat as if pulling it closed. He is wearing dark shoes. The background is a plain, untextured off-white color. There are no additional objects or elements in the drawing, with all focus placed on the solitary figure. The overall composition is centered, with the figure occupying most of the vertical space in the image.
title: Figurehead: "Samuel Skolfield"
